Question:
For a new teammate, who initiates and fulfills the standard equipment request, and what training must be completed before customer-data access?

Retrieved context (grouped by document):
=== Document: OPS-001 — Vendor, Travel, and Equipment Operations Policy ===

[Section: Equipment Requests]
Chunk ID: efa74b64-3c3e-4f86-bec3-63476871ca6b
Score: 0.6468
Content:
Equipment Requests

Standard equipment includes a laptop, charger, headset, keyboard, mouse, and monitor. New-hire equipment is initiated by HR Admin and fulfilled by IT Admin. Replacement equipment requires the employee to state whether the request is due to breakage, loss, upgrade, or accessibility need.

Equipment above the standard bundle requires manager approval. Lost equipment that may contain company data must be reported to IT Admin immediately and should not wait for the next business day.

[Section: Vendor Onboarding]
Chunk ID: c83e3811-1cf5-4479-899f-fd76bac98f5a
Score: 0.4583
Content:
Vendor Onboarding

New vendors require a vendor intake request before work begins. The requester must provide vendor legal name, business purpose, expected start date, estimated annual spend, data access level, and contract owner.

| Vendor Risk | Example | Required Review |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Low | Office supplies, training materials | Operations |
| Moderate | Contractor with project files | Operations and Legal |
| High | Vendor processing company or customer data | Operations, Legal, IT Admin |
| Financial | Vendor paid through invoice or purchase order | Operations and Finance |

Vendors may not receive company data, customer data, credentials, or building access until required reviews are complete.

=== Document: HR-001 — Employee Handbook ===

[Section: Onboarding Basics]
Chunk ID: 3c0ff18d-c2c6-4655-b39f-b0594d3ea77d
Score: 0.5826
Content:
Onboarding Basics

New employees complete onboarding during their first 10 business days. Required onboarding includes security training, benefits enrollment, department orientation, and access review. Managers are responsible for assigning a buddy and scheduling the first 30-day check-in.

Employees should complete mandatory security awareness training before accessing customer data or production systems.

=== Document: IT-002 — Device and BYOD Security Policy ===

[Section: Local Storage]
Chunk ID: 0d9d7c45-66f4-4fba-8b47-f9e8922840c6
Score: 0.4985
Content:
Local Storage

Customer data, restricted data, and regulated data should not be stored locally unless there is a documented business need and approved protection. Files should be stored in company-approved cloud storage with access controls.

=== Document: IT-003 — Data Classification and Handling Policy ===

[Section: Sharing Rules]
Chunk ID: 641b43bd-0e3e-47fd-87e5-20318fd50820
Score: 0.4786
Content:
Sharing Rules

Employees may share data only with people who have a business need and appropriate access. Confidential and Restricted data must not be shared in public channels or with unapproved external recipients.

Sales materials may be shared externally only when marked as customer-approved or public-facing.

[Section: Classification Levels]
Chunk ID: 71a7e7e6-af8a-4b5d-b77b-852b30df7f5a
Score: 0.4611
Content:
Classification Levels

Northstar uses four data classification levels: Public, Internal, Confidential, and Restricted.

Public data is approved for external sharing. Internal data is intended for Northstar employees. Confidential data includes customer business information, financial forecasts, non-public sales materials, and employee operational data. Restricted data includes secrets, credentials, regulated customer data, privileged security records, and sensitive HR case material.

=== Document: LEGAL-001 — Contract, NDA, and Data Retention Policy ===

[Section: Access Notice]
Chunk ID: f10db009-dee2-4cab-9081-6fc64591228d
Score: 0.4624
Content:
Access Notice

This document is restricted to Sales Representatives, Managers, HR Admins, and IT Admins. It contains internal legal operating guidance and should not be shown to general employees or external parties.

[Section: Contract Approval Process]
Chunk ID: 56f368ca-8cf8-4eec-b828-67bb1302a583
Score: 0.4185
Content:
Contract Approval Process

| Contract Type | Legal Review | Finance Review | Final Approver |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Standard customer order form under USD 25,000 ARR | Optional unless redlines exist | Deal Desk | Sales Manager |
| Customer contract with security addendum | Required | Deal Desk | Sales Director |
| Vendor agreement under USD 10,000 | Required if data processing applies | Finance | Department Manager |
| Vendor agreement USD 10,000 or above | Required | Finance | Department Leader |
| Employment-related agreement | Required | HR Admin | People Leader |

No employee may sign a contract on behalf of Northstar unless they are listed in the signature authority register maintained by Legal Operations.

=== Document: SALES-001 — Sales Playbook ===

[Section: Ideal Customer Profile]
Chunk ID: 037fbef6-587e-4d72-9f87-b78e4060a1e4
Score: 0.4556
Content:
Ideal Customer Profile

Northstar is best suited for operations teams with complex approvals, recurring data quality issues, and reporting delays across multiple departments. Strong-fit customers often have 500 to 5,000 employees and existing workflow tools that lack executive reporting.

Priority industries are finance operations, healthcare operations, logistics, and professional services.

=== Document: SUPPORT-001 — Support Escalation, SLA, and Refund Guide ===

[Section: Access Notice]
Chunk ID: f6f2d7c1-cbc7-490f-b532-80f5fe4fd490
Score: 0.4464
Content:
Access Notice

This guide is restricted to Sales Representatives and Managers. It contains internal customer handling, refund, and escalation guidance and should not be shared with customers as written.
